title: 371. Closest Binary Search Tree Value II

examples.explanation: Distances grow as 4 (0.286), 3 (0.714), 5 (1.286), 2 (1.714), 1 (2.714), so the two closest are 4 and 3 in any order.
The single value is the only candidate.
The closest distances are 5 and 7 (1.0 each) and then 4 (2.0).
